events.title: Seeking Vendor Applications
events.description:
The TR Site is proud to announce its inaugural “Sleigh Shop at the Carriage House” — sponsored by Wegmans.

This two-day artisan market will take place on Small Business Saturday (Sat, Nov 28) and continue through Sunday, November 29th. It will be open from 10:00am to 5:00pm each day.

Artisans/vendors who are interested in participating are invited to fill out an application.

Note that applications must be submitted no later than November 5th to be included in promotional marketing. We are unable to guarantee that artisans/vendors who submit applications after that date will be acknowledged in marketing materials.

Please return application & payment to:

TR Inaugural Site

Attn: Genna Munoz-Mages

641 Delaware Ave

Buffalo, NY 14202

events.title: Sleigh Shop Holiday Market
events.description:
You are Cordially Invited . . .  Please join the TR Site for our Inaugural “Sleigh Shop at the Carriage House” * Presented by Wegmans *

This two-day artisan market will take place on Small Business Saturday (Sat, Nov 28) and continue through Sunday, November 29th. The Sleigh Shop will be open from 10am to 5pm each day. Our local vendors will be offering an array of unique gift ideas for everyone on your list, and the TR Site’s Carriage House will be decorated for the season by the 8th District Federated Garden Clubs of NYS.

Participating vendors include:

Chits & Chat

Darling Desa Designs

8th District Garden Clubs

Indipendants Jewelry

Love Life Do Stuff

Paintings by Barbara Brown

Pivot Party Solutions

. . . and more!

Our “Poinsettia Bar” will also have a selection of festive holiday cocktails & mocktails available for purchase.

Admission is $6 per person (over 18), and includes entry to the Sleigh Shop, and a tour of the museum (first come, first serve).

In addition, the TR Site’s bookstore will be offering a 25% discount all weekend.

Be sure to stop by and fill your sleigh with unique gifts!!
